summary: Beginner framework continues to prioritize understanding account/product/risk structure before tactical selection.
Dividend analysis reinforces durability of cash flows over headline yield.
Short-selling analysis adds market-microstructure literacy: distinguish borrowed short selling from prohibited naked short selling and treat rule details as time-sensitive.
Across the checkpoint, historical rates, tax limits, broker events, and trading rules must not be promoted to current facts without official revalidation.
change_conflict: No durable conflict with the existing long-term diversification/risk-management framework was identified.
The 2021 short-selling restart timeline is historical; current KRX controls include NSDS and strengthened naked-short-selling prevention.
